mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases above 0.5% and unemployment rate declines below 4.5% indicate tightening policy with labor market strength, triggering recession risk and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
